description:
Sign structured Clarity data using SIP-018 standard. Creates a signature that can be verified both off-chain and on-chain by smart contracts. Use cases: meta-transactions, off-chain voting, permits, proving address control. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

domain.description: Domain binding for the signature. Prevents cross-app and cross-version replay.

message.description: The structured data to sign as a JSON object. Use type hints for explicit types: {type: 'uint', value: 100}, {type: 'principal', value: 'SP...'}, etc. Implicit conversion: strings->utf8, numbers->int, booleans->bool.

name: sip018_sign
